title: 第 13章 深山老林-《穿越60带着空间当保安》
content:
第(1/3)页

    王野出门看见周围四下无人，先溜进了村子的库房，在存放种子的房间看见一袋袋的种子，异常欣喜。

    王野打开袋子，一袋一袋看着，花生，小麦，玉米没了。一样拿了一小把收进空间。边走边用心神在空间里栽种下刚得到的种子。

    王野这次打定了主意要进深山。一路上，王野都没有刻意去寻找小型猎物。碰到了就打，绝不改变方向。一路无事，走了两个多小时，王野发现周围的树木越来越粗壮，很明显这是进入深山了。

    王野收起玩世不恭的心态，开始认真起来，精神力全开，经过十来天的锻炼，不论体力还是精神力都有了长足的进步。

    现在体力已经相当于两个成年人，精神力也可以探查200多米的范围了。辅助射击已经能在精神力范围内百发百中了，这就很变态了。这种射击水平在部队里都是凤毛麟角。

    走进深林，没多远就发现了一窝野猪。大猪两头带着三头小猪。王野这次没有像上次一样跟踪寻找机会，悄悄摸近，在距离三十多米的地方爬上一棵视野最开阔的大树。

    王野毫不迟疑，举枪射击。先打大猪，后打小猪，一气呵成。就算是王野有精神力加持，还是让一头小猪跑了。王野也没有懊悔，还是老办法，从空间里拿出三米长的大棍子，一头一头的收进空间。

    不作停留继续前进，不知不觉间来到了一处峭壁进入眼帘。王野看着峭壁欣喜若狂，王野不是欣赏美景，而是在峭壁上有一群山羊。太好了！终于有不一样的食材了。想起前世的羊肉串，涮羊肉，王野就开始咽口水。

    前世就因为吃着羊肉串喝着啤酒，才被大卡车送来这个时代，王野也是够没出息的，还心心念念这一口。王野静静的等着山羊向峭壁上爬。

    当爬到一多半儿时，王野举枪射击，一枪一个小朋友。打完子弹的枪就被收进空间快速装弹继续射击，一连打了十几枪，看到剩余的山羊全跑没影了

    王野才赶紧跑到峭壁地下开始收山羊，连摔死加上打死的一共17只，收获满满，这下子可以食物自由了。看了看时间已经中午了，取出大锅开饭。

    因为打到了这么多山羊，王野也有点得意忘形，开始美滋滋的吃起了卤肉。吃着吃着王野觉得后背发凉，没有任何犹豫身体向旁边滚去。

    滚出去后定了一下心神，王野心想：“我去尼玛！老虎看体型身长得有两米多，这绝对是一只成年华北虎，玛德！一定是山羊的血腥味儿把这头畜生引过来的，前世因为羊肉串自己来了一个空中飞人，这一世又因为羊肉串马上要成为虎口美食。”

    转头上树，别逗了，老虎是会爬树的。虽然不像豹子那样擅长，但是王野估计肯定比自己爬树快。这是王野前世在动物园看见的。三四米高的木桩子，老虎两下就爬上去了。你要是敢回头，它就敢扑上来。一爪子一千多斤的力量，必死无疑，绝对没有痛苦。

    王野从空间里取出短刀，躬下身子摆出攻击姿势。这是三爷爷教的。一人一虎间隔三米开始对峙，这是要徒手搏虎吗？

    别逗了，七米之外枪快，七米之内枪又准又快。说时迟那时快，王野从空间内取出长枪同时扣动扳机。拉栓继续，在危险的刺激下王野三秒内开了五枪，枪枪爆头。老虎也在扑食的动作中饮恨而终。王野后怕的瘫坐在地上，大口大口的喘着粗气。

    足足过了十几分钟，王野才缓过来，在确定老虎死透了后，把老虎收进空间，这老虎一身都是宝，虎骨虎鞭就算是虎肉都有药用价值。快走，快走，可不能再浪了，真把自己浪没了得多少人伤心呀！现在可不像前世，一人吃饱全家不饿。

    一直走出了一两公里，王野的心情才平复下来。精神力全开，不光要监视周围有没有大型猎物，最主要的是要小心蛇虫鼠蚁，这周围的山里可是有很多毒蛇的。短尾蝮蛇，华北蝮蛇，这些毒蛇的毒性和眼镜蛇的毒性不相上下。

    这要是被咬一口连抢救都省了。走着走着，通过精神力发现了一个山洞。从山洞洞口的样式来看，这山洞是人工凿出来的。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Wang Ye went out and saw no one around, so he sneaked into the village warehouse first, and was very happy to see bags of seeds in the room where the seeds were stored.

Wang Ye opened the bag and looked at each bag one by one. The peanuts, wheat and corn were gone.I also took a small handful and put them into the space.While walking, use your mind to plant the newly obtained seeds in the space.

Wang Ye made up his mind to go into the mountains this time.Along the way, Wang Ye did not deliberately look for small prey.Hit them when you encounter them and never change direction.The journey was uneventful. After walking for more than two hours, Wang Ye found that the trees around him were getting thicker and thicker. It was obvious that they were entering deep mountains.

Wang Ye put away his cynicism and became serious, with full mental strength. After more than ten days of training, both physical and mental strength have made great progress.

Now the physical strength is equivalent to that of two adults, and the mental strength can also explore a range of more than 200 meters.The auxiliary shooting can already hit the target within the range of mental power, which is very abnormal.This level of shooting is rare in the army.

Walking into the deep forest, we found a nest of wild boars not far away.Two big pigs and three little pigs.This time Wang Ye did not follow and look for opportunities like last time. He quietly approached and climbed up a big tree with the widest view more than thirty meters away.

Wang Ye did not hesitate and raised his gun to shoot.Hit the big pig first, then the little pig, all in one go.Even with Wang Ye's spiritual blessing, he still let a little pig run away.Wang Ye didn't regret it. He still used the old method, taking out a three-meter-long stick from the space and putting it into the space one by one.

​​Continuing forward without stopping, we came to a cliff before we knew it.Wang Ye looked at the cliff and was ecstatic. Wang Ye was not admiring the beautiful scenery, but there was a herd of goats on the cliff.Very good!Finally there are different ingredients.Thinking of the mutton skewers and mutton boiling in his previous life, Wang Ye started to swallow his saliva.

In his previous life, he was transported to this era by a truck just because he was eating mutton skewers and drinking beer. Wang Ye was quite hopeless, yet he still thought about this.Wang Ye waited quietly for the goat to climb up the cliff.

When they reached more than half a mile, Wang Ye raised his gun and shot one child at a time.After finishing the bullets, the gun was put into the space and quickly loaded and continued shooting. After firing more than ten shots in a row, I saw that all the remaining goats had disappeared.

Wang Ye then hurried to the bottom of the cliff and started collecting goats. A total of 17 goats were killed by falling and beating. The harvest was full. Now he could have free food.After looking at the time, it was already noon, I took out the big pot and started cooking.

Because he had hunted so many goats, Wang Ye was a little carried away and began to eat braised pork with great pleasure.While eating, Wang Ye felt a chill on his back and rolled to the side without any hesitation.

After getting out and calming down, Wang Ye thought: "I'm sorry! The tiger looks more than two meters long. This is definitely an adult North China tiger, Mader! It must be the bloody smell of the goat that attracted this beast. In the previous life, he became a trapeze artist because of the mutton skewers, and in this life, the mutton skewers will soon become a tiger's delicacy."

Turn around and go to the tree. Don’t be ridiculous. Tigers can climb trees.Although he is not as good at climbing trees as a leopard, Wang Ye is probably faster than himself at climbing trees.This is what Wang Ye saw in the zoo in his previous life.The tiger climbed up the three- to four-meter-high wooden stake in two clicks.If you dare to look back, it will dare to pounce on you.With a claw that weighs more than a thousand kilograms, death is inevitable and there is absolutely no pain.

Wang Ye took out the short knife from the space, bowed down and assumed an attack posture.This is what Third Grandpa taught me.A man and a tiger start a confrontation three meters apart. Is this to fight the tiger with bare hands?

“Don’t be ridiculous, a gun is fast from seven meters away, but it is accurate and fast within seven meters.Soon enough, Wang Ye took out the spear from the space and pulled the trigger at the same time.Pulling the bolt continued, and under the stimulation of danger, Wang Ye fired five shots in three seconds, hitting his head with each gun.The tiger also died in the act of pounce on food.Wang Yehou collapsed on the ground in fear, breathing heavily.

It took more than ten minutes for Wang Ye to recover. After confirming that the tiger was dead, he took the tiger into the space. This tiger was full of treasures. Tiger bones, tiger whips and even tiger meat had medicinal value.Go quickly, go quickly, don't waste any more, you will waste yourself and make many people sad!Now it is not like the previous life, where one person has enough to eat and the whole family is not hungry.

Wang Ye finally calmed down after walking a kilometer or two.With full mental strength, you must not only monitor the surroundings for large prey, but the most important thing is to be careful of snakes, insects, rats, and ants. There are many venomous snakes in the surrounding mountains.Short-tailed adder, North China adder, these venomous snakes are as venomous as cobras.

If you get bitten, you won’t even need to save yourself.While walking, I discovered a cave through my spiritual power.Judging from the shape of the cave entrance, this cave was dug manually.
Page (1/3)
